tacticResearchNotes.purpose: Broad baseline template set for squad-fit and tactical comparison; not claimed to be a set of optimal FM20 meta tactics.
design: Templates cover genuinely different structures/styles rather than many near-duplicates.
Every added tactic uses only role keys already present in the supplied catalogue.
Descriptions and requirements are intended to support later tactical-coherence scoring and UI explanation.
Long-term design should allow role/duty optimisation within formations instead of treating templates as immutable.
